projects.title: Theme System
projects.blurb: Six complete looks driven by one JSON file, each owning its own layout, type and motion: Auckland 2077, Neon Terminal, Skux Deluxe, Krazy Kunt and the two quiet ones.

projects.title: X/i\D Website
projects.blurb: The storefront itself: hash-routed views, the persistent player and queue, cycled backdrops, the EPK and the beat store. Plain files, no build step, no framework.

projects.title: Admin Dashboard
projects.blurb: A GitHub-backed console for the whole site: uploads releases, beats and photos, edits links and credits, and writes the manifests the pages read. Publishes straight to the branch.
